chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hassan al-Jammal, who said: Hashim ibn Abi Umara al-Janbi narrated to me, saying:
I heard the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) say: 'I am the Eye of God, and I am the Hand of God, and I am the Side of God, and I am the Door of God.'

key_terms.بَابُ اللَّهِ: Door/Gate of God — the Imam as the means of access to divine knowledge and guidance
key_terms.جَنْبُ اللَّهِ: Side of God — a Quranic phrase (39:56) meaning proximity and nearness to God
key_terms.عَيْنُ اللَّهِ: Eye of God — the Imam as divine witness and overseer
key_terms.يَدُ اللَّهِ: Hand of God — the Imam as divine power and agent

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about being the Eye, Hand, Side, and Door of God?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Hashim ibn Abi Umara al-Janbi reports hearing Imam Ali (peace be upon him) make a fourfold declaration of his divine proximity and authority — identifying himself as God's Eye, Hand, Side, and Door. In Shia theological tradition, these expressions are understood metaphorically: the Imam is the locus through whom divine will is exercised and through whom believers access God's guidance. The terms 'Eye' (عَيْن), 'Hand' (يَد), 'Side' (جَنْب), and 'Door' (بَاب) are all Quranic concepts applied here to the Imam's unique ontological station as the representative of God on earth.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hassan Al Jammal who said, ‘Hashim Bin Abu Umara Al Junbiyyi narrated to me saying,

‘I heard Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> am an eye of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and I<sup>asws</sup> am a Hand of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and I<sup>asws</sup> am a Side of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and I<sup>asws</sup> am a Door of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn abu Nasr from Hassan al-Jammal who has said that Hashim ibn abu ‘Ammara al-Janbi reported to him this.
“I heard Amirul Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) saying, ‘I am the eyes of Allah. I am the hands of Allah. I am the sides of Allah. I am the door to Allah.”
